in_sanskrit.name: Krishanu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Krishna
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Krishanu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A variant of the name Krishna, meaning 'Little Krishna'. Krishna is a widely revered god in Hinduism, known for his mischievous nature, love for butter, and divine powers.
